description: Introducing "Hair of the Dog", Suff Daddy's newest musical journey that blends instrumental hip-hop, electronic and dance genres. This album invites listeners to unwind from start to finish. Once again a Suff Daddy album thrives on the pure brilliance of his own unique way to create music. The cover art, painted by the renowned artist @itsallinsideus, adds an intriguing visual dimension to the experience. Check this gem and discover the pure talent that lies within.
credits:
All songs produced by Suff Daddy
Master by Mark Pfurtscheller
Painting by Mitch (@itsallinsideus) 
Artwork by Robert Winter & Jeremias Diekmann
Published by Jabibi Publishing
